_doc: Cookie consent, read by NT_Consent (src/Consent/class-consent.php) and handed to assets/js/cookie-consent.js. VERSIONS: bump accept_version to re-ask EVERYONE; bump reject_version to re-ask only the people who declined. A full rejection is stored for reject_hours only, so the banner returns by itself. Categories marked required (and any category keyed 'necessary') are always on, never shown as a switch and never written into the stored cookie. Every word below is what the visitor reads - nothing is hard-coded in PHP or JS.

banner.title: We use a few cookies
banner.text: Some keep the site working, the rest only help us see which pages people actually read. You choose.
banner.prefs_text: Switch off anything you would rather we did not use. You can change this any time from the footer.

categories.label: Strictly necessary
categories.text: Remembering your basket, your cookie choice and keeping forms secure. The site cannot work without these.

categories.label: Analytics
categories.text: Anonymous counts of which pages get read, so we know what to write more of.

categories.label: Marketing
categories.text: Lets us show our own offers to people who have visited before. No data is sold, ever.
